title: scheduler exec: the host half, a gRPC server on a unix socket in a labelled herdr pane that runs an allowlisted verb table (herdr, the seat script, the queue script, the event writer) with a timeout and returns exit code and output tails
text: It decides nothing: a verb not in its table is refused, an argument with a newline is refused, every call is one JSON log line. Its socket is the control plane and stays whatever the bus becomes (card C15). Revised 2026-10-13 (SPEC-16 1.1.0): the text said it is the one place that changes when the bus lands; with NATS deferred and the bus a set of files in the state root, the socket is never the bus, so nothing here waits on a bus. Rejected: keeping the sentence as a future note (it would cite a deferred decision as a plan).
